OpenVector uses the Independent JPEG Group's jpeg-6b compressor.
This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

The selected C sources, headers and README match the IJG component distributed
with Qt 4.4.3 byte for byte. source-identity.json records the official archive
URL, archive digest and file digests. Copyright and license terms remain in
README. No ansi2knr source is included.

OpenVector's separate wrapper provides a memory destination, per-call arena,
trap-based error reporting and top-down BGRA-to-RGB scanlines. The build uses
NO_GETENV to avoid host environment access.
Default compression is quality 75, baseline JPEG, RGB input and 96-DPI density.

The JavaScript caller, wrapper and build script are OpenVector application
code. The resulting WebAssembly module requires no Qt installation, native
DLL, host import, filesystem or network access.
